design: Exploratory secondary analysis of published AgentDyn marginal tables and an independent archived-log pilot
primary_population: All configurations with clean utility, attacked utility and ASR for all three suites in Tables 9 through 17
primary_comparison: Complete rectangular panel of the same 12 model labels and 10 configurations; separately report the two aligned-model rows
primary_quantity: Joint task completion and failure of the specified attack objective
identification: Frechet bounds from paired marginal rates, aggregate versus suite-stratified; assumes matched evaluated populations and weights
pairwise_comparison: Same-model configuration pairs; strict separation of feasible intervals
decision_sensitivity: Illustrative score J minus lambda times A, lambda from 0 to 5; not a calibrated deployment risk estimate
pilot_validation: Use all existing 288 pilot logs, preserving the initial sample; no new LLM calls
reporting: Distinguish identification ranges from exploratory bootstrap intervals and report source table inconsistencies instead of silently correcting them
download_limit: Larger raw-log download attempted but proxy connection timed out; inventory counts are not analyzed outcome records
